plan.title: feat(scope): part line, pre-merge story-line check and --write-story-line (#6310 slice A)

narratives.Description: Slice A of the accepted #6310 design: a `deft-story-part: N` PR-body line, a pre-merge check that refuses a product PR of a running story without a story line, and a `--write-story-line` tool that appends the line for the author. After it, no product PR of an active story merges without a basis for the identity join.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Slice A of the accepted #6310 design: the part line, the pre-merge check, and the tool that writes the story line for the author, so that no product PR of an active story merges without a basis for the identity join.

Bound contract: successor lean 6887155397 on #6310, Bound 1 and the matching pre-merge fixtures of Bound 5 (accepted synthesis 6887284787), plus the amendment 6887505436 (the tool writes the line). Both are the contract. Slices B (join and attestation) and C (disposition grant) are separate child issues. Each slice has its own issue so that each brief completes from exactly one PR with its own `deft-story` line.

## Scope

1. `deft-story-part: N` is a new PR-body line, parsed like the mark (line start, digits only).
2. In `pr:check-closing-keywords` (live PR mode), a product PR fails when it carries neither a sole `deft-story: N` nor a sole `deft-story-part: N` and either its body names issue N with `Refs` / `Tracking` / `Related` while N has a running brief in `active/`, or a running brief on the head carries `metadata.productPullRequest` equal to this PR. The failure prints both lines, says which to use, and names the `--write-story-line` command. Both lines for the same N in one body refuse. The mark keeps today's rules.
3. In `evaluateFullStoryMarkAdmission`, a part-line PR with no mark that changes N's nonterminal brief passes only when the brief's `metadata.productPullRequest` on the head equals its value at the merge base, and fails when the head value names this PR or otherwise differs. The part line is not a finalize close signal. Plan-id adoption on a multi-running tip accepts a sole part line the same way as the mark, for mint selection only.
4. The same advice goes in the #3781 refusal (`formatRefusal`), the two `Refs` advisories in `pr-closing-keywords/main.ts`, the mark note in `plan-id-adopter.ts`, `scm/github.md`, and the PR template, which stops advising `Closes #N` for an active story.
5. `pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file <path> --write-story-line` (offline mode): when the branch changes or names a running brief for issue N and the body has neither line, it appends `deft-story: N` to the body file and exits 0. With `--part`, it appends `deft-story-part: N`.
6. The pre-PR path (`deft-directive-pre-pr` skill and `pre-pr:run`) runs that step on the body file before the PR is opened. The swarm dispatch envelope names the line for each story.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a product PR for a running story whose body has `Refs #N` only, when `pr:check-closing-keywords` runs in live mode, then it fails, prints both lines and names `--write-story-line`.
- Given a PR with no issue reference whose head brief names it as `metadata.productPullRequest`, then the check fails the same way.
- Given a body with both `deft-story: N` and `deft-story-part: N`, then the check fails.
- Given a part-line PR that stamps evidence on the brief and leaves `metadata.productPullRequest` unchanged, then it passes; given one that sets that stamp to itself, then it fails.
- Given a part-line PR on a tip with several running briefs, then plan-id adoption resolves its plan id.
- Given a body file for a branch that names a running brief for issue N, with neither line, when `pr:check-closing-keywords --body-file <path> --write-story-line` runs, then the file ends with `deft-story: N` and the command exits 0.
- Given the same input with `--part`, then the file ends with `deft-story-part: N`.
- Given a body file that already has one of the lines for N, then the file is unchanged.
- The pre-PR path runs the write step before the PR is opened, and the PR template no longer advises `Closes #N` for an active story.

Refs #6310.

design-critique: not warranted, because this slice implements Bound 1 of the design already accepted on #6310 (lean 6887155397, synthesis 6887284787) and its amendment 6887505436, and adds no mechanism.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent opening a product PR for an active story, I want the pre-merge check to require a story line and a tool that writes it, so that every merged product PR gives the completion join a basis.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Parse `deft-story-part: N` like the mark (line start, digits only) in packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts and types.ts.
2. In live mode of `pr:check-closing-keywords`, fail a product PR that has neither sole line when its body refs a running story or its head brief stamps it as `metadata.productPullRequest`; print both lines and name `--write-story-line`; refuse both lines for one N.
3. In `evaluateFullStoryMarkAdmission` and intent-constraint/plan-id-adopter.ts, admit a part-line PR only when the head `productPullRequest` equals the merge-base value, and accept a sole part line for plan-id adoption.
4. Add offline `--body-file <path> --write-story-line [--part]` that appends the line once, and call it from `pre-pr:run` (packages/runtime/src/pre-pr-run.ts) and the pre-PR skill.
5. Align the advice in scm/github.md, both PR templates (no `Closes #N` for an active story) and the preamble; add main, gh, plan-id-adopter, pre-pr-run and content-contract tests.
